mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, it is a clear 26 degrees by Reddan Soccer Park under a first quarter moon. If you look up at 5:44 PM, you can catch the space station rising over Mount Horeb and traveling toward the Northeast near the Home Depot.

City Hall has released various election notices for the fall and spring ballots. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects including a site plan for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park.
We have plenty of fun ahead, starting with live music at Bailey's Run today and yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.

In a report covering October 18 through October 24, officers responded to a call on October 25 where a man was arrested for O W I after being found at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Mint Explosion is the flavor of the day, and our local Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
